description: This PHP file is a Smarty plugin for SugarCRM, providing a function to display inline help icons with associated tooltip functionality. It includes license and modification history, and defines the smarty_function_sugar_help() function which generates HTML markup for a help icon with JavaScript behavior.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_help
methods.description: Generates an HTML image element for an inline help icon with attached JavaScript tooltip behavior, using parameters for help text and positioning.
